The next generation Python tooling.

Usage: poetry [options] <command>

Commands:
  add           Add a new dependency to pyproject.toml
  remove        Remove a dependency from pyproject.toml
  install       Install the project dependencies
  lock          Lock the project dependencies
  run           Run a command within the project environment
  shell         Open a shell within the virtual environment
  build         Build the project into a distributable package
  publish       Publish the project to a PyPI-compatible repository
  check         Validate pyproject.toml and poetry.lock
  env           Display or manipulate the project virtual environment

Options:
  -C, --directory DIRECTORY  Working directory for the Poetry command
  -q, --quiet                Do not output any message
  -v, --verbose              Increase the verbosity of messages
  --ansi / --no-ansi         Force (or disable) ANSI output
  -V, --version               Display the Poetry version
  -h, --help                   Show help and exit
